workstreams.label: WORLD
workstreams.evidence_state: L_AshMap_Assembly loads successfully, MapCheck is clean, NavMeshBounds/Recast were rebuilt and saved; 210 Engine BasicShape actors remain to be replaced or explicitly approved before production lock.

workstreams.label: COMBAT
workstreams.evidence_state: Packaged Development combat regression passed after the navigation rebuild: damage, three-hit combo, dodge, double jump, lock-on, notify-driven timing, hit-window callback and weapon sweep verified.

workstreams.label: AI
workstreams.evidence_state: Packaged navigation QA now passes with RecastNavMesh-Default. Celestial Wolf and Bone Beast accepted MoveToActor requests and moved hundreds of units; the dedicated target travelled 1003.9 units before PASS.

workstreams.label: CHARACTERS
workstreams.evidence_state: Hero, Celestial Wolf, Bone Beast and Ash Warden load with runtime combat data; remaining production mesh and technical-art acceptance is incomplete.

workstreams.label: ANIMATION
workstreams.evidence_state: Eighteen motion clips are visible to runtime and six attack clips passed packaged notify-driven timing validation; broader production animation coverage remains incomplete.

workstreams.label: UI/UX
workstreams.evidence_state: Major player-facing interfaces now run as real UE5.7 UMG widgets: operations/tactical menu, main menu, pause menu and gameplay HUD. Runtime-bound health/stamina/objective/resources/boss UI, real menu buttons and packaged main/pause/operations QA all pass.

workstreams.label: AUDIO
workstreams.evidence_state: Runtime audio device initializes correctly, but sixteen production audio masters remain unresolved.

workstreams.label: QUESTS
workstreams.evidence_state: Packaged objective progression QA passed from Ash Gate reach to boss defeat and reward grant; authored narrative/quest content is still incomplete.

workstreams.label: OPTIMIZATION
workstreams.evidence_state: Shipping and Development cook/package succeed and a real D3D12 packaged benchmark launches on RTX 3050; formal frame-time percentile and memory acceptance is still not captured.

workstreams.label: QA
workstreams.evidence_state: Final UMG_COMPLETE Development BuildCookRun succeeded with 0 cook errors. Packaged runtime confirmed operations, system menu and gameplay HUD widget construction; main-menu, pause/resume and operations-navigation QA all pass.
